pages.text: The $(item)Recycling Bin$() destroys unwanted items and converts them into $(thing)Positive Vibes$() — a fluid representing pure distilled good vibes. Each item destroyed produces $(bold)10 mB$() of Positive Vibes. The bin holds up to $(bold)10,000 mB$().

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: $(bold)Right-click$() to open the recycling UI. Items placed in the input slot are converted to Positive Vibes when destroyed.$(br2)$(bold)Right-click with a Glass Bottle$() on the bin (when it holds at least 250 mB) to fill a $(item)Positive Vibes Bottle$().$(br2)The UI also has a fluid transfer pane with input and output slots for container items such as buckets and bottles.

pages.title: Shift-Click Routing
pages.text: When clicking items into the bin's UI:$(br2)$(bold)Normal click$() — routes buckets and bottles to the fluid transfer slot.$(br2)$(bold)Shift-click$() — routes empty buckets and empty bottles to the fluid transfer slot; everything else is sent directly to the void and destroyed immediately.
